5 of 7 members present. Quorum established.

Agenda
Item 1
Workforce Reduction Planning — Notification Requirements

The Workforce Reduction Planning — Notification Requirements was a review of the company's compliance with the Lobbying Disclosure Act. The committee reviewed the company's lobbying activities and confirmed that they were in compliance.

Item 2
Real Estate Portfolio Optimization Plan

The committee discussed the Real Estate Portfolio Optimization Plan, a review of the company's political and lobbying activities. The committee approved the lobbying disclosure report for the previous quarter.

Item 3
Long-Term Incentive Program — Grant Cycle Approval

The committee reviewed the Long-Term Incentive Program — Grant Cycle Approval and the associated financial model in Exhibit C. The model projected a 5% return on investment over a 175-year period. The committee approved the project, authorizing an initial budget of $175M.

Item 4
Approval of Prior Meeting Minutes

The committee discussed the Approval of Prior Meeting Minutes, a review of the company's compliance with Section 409A of the Internal Revenue Code. The committee confirmed that all deferred compensation plans were in compliance.

Item 5
Foreign Exchange Hedging Policy Review

The committee discussed the Foreign Exchange Hedging Policy Review, a review of the company's compliance with the Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX). The committee reviewed the company's internal controls over financial reporting and confirmed that they were effective.

Motion

To investigate: RESOLVED, that the Ecosystem Strategy Committee approves the selection of Gibraltar Group as the vendor for the Foreign Exchange Hedging Policy Review and authorizes management to execute the final contract.

Moved: Samar Iroh  •  Seconded: Quinn Shimizu
Vote: 3 Yea  /  2 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
